newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita says its strength lies in hardware.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita says its strength lies in hardware.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co said on Thursday it would continue to strengthen hardware as its core business in era of the Internet and digital broadcasting.
"Matsushita's strength lies in hardware manufacturing," Matsushita's director Yoshio Hino told a news conference.
"While putting our major emphasis on hardware, we will move into some quarters of online business," he said.
Hino said alliances with various companies were possible in that field, where digital content, computer networking technology and satellite digital broadcasting were becoming vital assets.

Hino made the comment when asked about the aggressive strategy of rival Sony Corp, which is rapidly diversifying into content and broadcasting businesses to become an overall provider in television programming, advertising and hardware.
"Everyone doesn't have to do the same," Hino said.
Matsushita, whose products are sold under the "National", "Panasonic" and "Technics" brand names, has so far not pushed into the content business.
Last year the firm was forced to sell a majority stake in American film-making unit MCA Inc because of management trouble.
It was also nudged out of the booming videogame market by Sony due to a lack of attractive game content.
"To cope with faster product cycles and rapid changes in the market, Matsushita needs to speed up management decisions," Hino said.
Some analysts say the rigid corporate structure has slowed decisions at Matsushita, despite its strong edge in technology.
